visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is seated on a light-colored yoga mat in a brightly lit, minimalist indoor studio. She is dressed in a white cropped tank top, dark blue athletic shorts, and high white socks. Next to her on the floor are two dark yoga blocks and a smartphone. A large mirror to her side reflects her profile. (2) She begins her exercise by arching her back over a black and white yoga wheel placed behind her lower back. She supports her head with her hands, elbows flared out. The background features a large wall art piece with soft pink and white wavy patterns. (3) Moving with control, she lifts her hips and extends her right leg vertically toward the ceiling while keeping her left leg bent. Her facial expression is focused and calm. (4) She transitions into a deep stretch, rolling her hips over the wheel until her legs pass over her head toward the floor behind her. She then smoothly rolls forward back to a seated position on the mat, finishing the sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle acoustic guitar strumming accompanied by a soft, melodic female vocal singing in English. The mood is calm and reflective. Studio silence provides a very clean background floor. (2) A subtle, high-frequency rustle of clothing is heard as the physical movement transitions. The music remains steady in tempo and volume. (3) A faint, low-bandwidth percussive thud occurs, lasting a fraction of a second, suggesting weight shifting on the yoga mat. The female singer continues a legato phrase. (4) As the video nears completion, the acoustic guitar continues its finger-picking pattern. Another soft fabric rustle is audible. (5) The vocal line concludes a phrase, and the music begins to fade out smoothly into silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a personal yoga practice journey, emphasizing the importance of patience and process over perfect performance. The combination of gentle music, focused movement, and encouraging subtitles creates an inspirational atmosphere for fitness enthusiasts.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a minimalist aesthetic and high-quality studio lighting to create a clean, aspirational look common in fitness lifestyle content. The synchronized text overlays reinforce the motivational theme.
